output.question: Where can I find Bank of America's latest annual report?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Bank of America’s latest annual report is its 2025 Annual Report. Find it on the official Annual Reports & Proxy Statements page at https://investor.bankofamerica.com/annual-reports-and-proxy-statements and select “2025 Annual Report” under 2025. An alternative is the SEC filing page at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70858/000007085826000209/0000070858-26-000209-index.html, which links to bofaannualreport2025.pdf.

key_facts.fact: As of November 11, 2026, the latest annual report listed on Bank of America Corporation’s official annual-report page is the 2025 Annual Report.
The SEC filing page links to bofaannualreport2025.pdf; the annual report to security holders was filed March 23, 2026, for the reporting period ended December 31, 2025.

caveats: The company’s annual-report listing does not display a publication date.
The company-hosted PDF returned a 403 error to the research browser; its link was verified on the official listing page.
